abilities.name: ROYAL IMPERATIVE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round: Into Them!: Friendly units have STRIKE-FIRST. Strike Sure: Friendly units’ melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

abilities.name: THE SPEAR OF ASPHOREN
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: THE SHIELD OF ULCHISS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time that unit uses a RETREAT ability, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

abilities.name: DUTIFUL SOULS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
abilities.effect: You can return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target is an INFANTRY unit, you can return D3 slain models to it instead.

abilities.name: VOLTAIC CHARGE
abilities.effect: Your general’s Akhelian Royal Weapons have Charge (+1 Damage).

abilities.name: SOUL STEALER
abilities.effect: If your general is in combat, Heal (D3) your general.

abilities.name: RAIDERS' RESOLVE
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly unit wholly within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: WAVE RIDER
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. KEYWORDS HERO, CAVALRY, FLY

abilities.name: BIOVOLTAIC BLAST
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit.
abilities.effect: For each 4-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. For each 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. KEYWORDS CAVALRY, FLY

abilities.name: BIOVOLTAIC BARRIER
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn. KEYWORDS CAVALRY, FLY ezstandalone.cmd.push(function() {ezstandalone.showAds(126)});

abilities.name: STRIKE ON THE MOVE
abilities.effect: This unit can use SHOOT abilities even if it used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn. KEYWORDS INFANTRY, REINFORCEMENTS
